title: Pokémon Omega Ruby/Alpha Sapphire - Battle! Lorekeeper Zinnia
description:
Zinnia's theme from Pokemon Omega Ruby/Alpha Sapphire. While it sounds almost unsampled, external percussions and an improved version of smw's @8 have been used. Could fit chases, bosses and any tense situations.

Note: Please be careful as tempo will be disturbed when tempo is raised for this music.
